issues.description: A timed-out run returns only {:error, :timeout} instead of {:error, :timeout, messages}, so the findings or verdicts it reported before the timeout are dropped and its unit is reported as failed rather than incomplete.

issues.description: The incomplete-unit filter tests length(incomplete) > 0 instead of comparing with the number of samples, so a batch whose other samples completed is still listed as only partly reviewed.

The done flag of a report_findings call is read as == true, so a finishing call that leaves done out (the documented default) is answered with the keep-reviewing message instead of closing the review.
A verifier run that failed records its unreported findings as {:error, :no_verdict} instead of the run's own error, so a timeout, crash, or step limit is reported to the caller as a missing verdict.
